summary_for_children: At-Takwir describes great changes of the Last Day in words, and swears by the dawn as it breathes.
environment_concept: A symbolic sequence of the surah's signs read as text over a calm sky; nothing of the end is pictured.
architecture_and_scenery: Calm sky with text overlay; dawn breathing.

activities.name: Read the signs
activities.description: Read each ayah; nothing is pictured.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration says these are described only in the Quran.
learning_objectives: Explain that the Day is described in the Quran

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
